description: The pie chart presents the distribution of items across topical categories for the paper “Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models,” showing 12 slices in total. The largest slice is labeled “AI/NLP Research” in blue at 24.3%, followed by “Econ. & Fin.” in teal at 18.4%. Other slices include “Game&Anime” in orange at 8.2%, “History” in yellow at 8.2%, “Daily Life” in light cyan at 7.1%, “Med & Health” in green at 6.7%, “Science” in light blue at 6.7%, “Business” in red at 5.9%, “Pet & Animal” in light orange at 5.5%, “Law” in pink at 5.1%, “Geography” in yellow-gold at 2.7%, and “Math” in green at 1.2%. Percentages are shown next to each category label outside the pie with leader lines pointing to the corresponding slices; there is no separate legend, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, with the slice order following their placement around the circle rather than an obvious sorted sequence.
